textures.subject: silvery river trout with an olive back, pink lateral stripe and small dark red spots
textures.prompt: Create ONE SQUARE, completely OPAQUE pixel-art texture atlas for a 3D voxel fish. This is a flat material sample sheet, NOT a drawing of a fish and NOT a fish silhouette. No transparency, no outlines, no empty black background. 64 by 64 pixel aesthetic with hard square pixel blocks. Every square inch filled. TOP THREE QUARTERS: continuous flat fish skin pattern, all-over scales or spots with no eyes or fins. LOWER QUARTER: horizontal fin-color band covering full width. In bottom-right corner only: a small pure BLACK square occupying rightmost 1/8 width and bottommost 1/8 height; directly to its left a same-sized pure IVORY square. These two tiny swatches are for separate eye geometry. No perspective, no lighting gradient, no text, no labels, no body parts, no animal illustration. Material description: silvery river trout with an olive back, pink lateral stripe and small dark red spots. Keep the upper left half especially fully filled with the main skin pattern.
